payload.title: mav duplicates the architect
payload.body: The architect position is one concept, held by four agents with identical role sections: the generic architect and the personas mav, nico and kino. nico adds a domain (this corpus's canon) and kino adds one (films); mav adds none, since it is the architect of whatever repository it is given, which is what the generic architect already is. Two holders of one scope is a duplicate sign. Separately, a generic architect listed as a dispatchable subagent contradicts the law that the design is not delegable. Recommendation: one general holder, launched as a main session and never dispatched; the operator chooses whether its name is architect or mav.
